reading.body:
Google does not publish megawatt capacity, square footage, or exact addresses for Arcola 2 or its other individual buildings in Northern Virginia, only aggregate investment figures at state level. Without disclosed power consumption, the facility's scale relative to AI training or inference workloads cannot be estimated from published specifications.

Arcola 2 is part of Google's larger Loudoun and Prince William County data center footprint, which received a $1 billion expansion announcement in April 2024. Virginia has 326 mapped data center facilities, of which only 23 publish power capacity figures totaling 1,375 megawatts. Google's disclosed Virginia capacity ranks 24th among published figures in the state, though this ranking reflects only facilities that report their own numbers and excludes Google's individual building specs.

The absence of building-level disclosure means Arcola 2 cannot be directly compared to competitors' disclosed capacity or assessed for its contribution to AI infrastructure scaling. Whether this campus matters to AI scaling depends on information Google has not made public.
